text:
lucas (Marketing): Drafting a compact launch pulse for Secure Enterprise: short brief + benchmark callout + webinar + routing checklist. Goal: publish one-pager and registration by EOD tomorrow. Feedback?

hannah (Product): Love the pulse idea. Add a 1-line risk/caveat about quantization impacts on hallucination rates. Also highlight automatic fallback to smaller-capacity models.

mike (Field): Benchmark suggestions: run with burst profile (200 concurrent clients, seq=256), model=redwood-alpha-quant. Share p50/p99, tokens-per-second, and cost per 1k tokens. Keep numbers consumer-friendly.

rhea (Sales): Inbound routing: recommend tags = {tier:enterprise, interest:private-vpc, usecase:high-security}. Route enterprise leads to AE-enterprise; on-prem requests to infra-specialist queue. Add auto-assign for trial requests.

mike (Field): Routing snippet for devs:
```yaml
rules:
  - when: tags.tier == 'enterprise' and tags.interest == 'private-vpc'
    assign: queue.AE-enterprise
    urgency: medium
  - when: tags.usecase == 'high-security'
    assign: queue.infra-specialist
    urgency: high
  - fallback: queue SDR-inbound
```

lucas (Marketing): Proposed benchmark bullets for slide: Hosted (standard): p50=120ms, p99=380ms, cost=$0.20 / 1k tokens. Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): p50=35ms, p99=60ms, throughput=150 req/s per GPU, cost-equivalent $0.05 / 1k tokens. Note: measurements at seq=256, batch sizing auto, quantized weights.

hannah (Product): Confirmed on Dedicated numbers except p99 might vary by model; add small footnote: "Dedicated SLOs depend on model family and sequence length; contact solutions for SLAs."

rhea (Sales): Webinar flow idea: 40m total — 7m market framing + 12m demo (deploy modes + console quick-tour) + 12m benchmark deep-dive + 6m customer panel/Q&A + CTAs. CTA: "Request a private trial" + register link. I'll draft registration copy.

lucas (Marketing): Registration landing copy (first pass): "Join our launch webinar: Secure inference at scale. See how teams cut latency & costs while meeting enterprise SLAs. Includes live demo + customer panel. Register now for a private trial." Thoughts?

mike (Field): Add a slide 1 customer blurb: "AcmeHealth reduced inference cost by 3x and met 99.95% uptime during pilot; Redwood handled sensitive workloads in our VPC." Two sentences max.

hannah (Product): SLA blurb for brief: "SLA: 99.95% uptime for Dedicated plans. Latency SLOs provided per deployment; contact sales for custom SLOs and on-prem commitments." Good to go.

ops-bot: Assets uploaded: /assets/launch-pulse-v1.pdf and /assets/webinar-landing/launch-pulse.html

lucas (Marketing): Two quick asks before I finalize v1: (1) @mike - can you confirm AcmeHealth blurb copy? (2) @hannah - final approval on the Dedicated p99 footnote. Will publish short launch post + webinar invite once confirmed. :rocket:
